name: blackbird-a5-drums
description: Punchy/forward 'American console' drum bus from the KIT Plugins BB A5 (Blackbird Studio API Legacy console strip) alone — the KIT/Blackbird counterpart to the UAD tight-70s-api chain. Mic-mode preamp drive (pre_amp_gain 35) adds even+odd console color + light peak-managing glue (raw peak +0.1 dB vs +2.3 dB EQ-only => the preamp is doing the densifying, not just EQ); 55L 4-band carves weight + de-box + modest air; HPF 40 Hz tightens sub. Crest stays ~11.5 (vs dry 11.58) so it's forward, not squashed. Keep MSTR BUSS OFF (it CLEANS the channel grit on this rig) and hum OFF. Built+measured 2026-06-03 on watercolors_drums_104bpm_8bar_a.
intended_for: a dry-ish, measured-balanced drum bus/loop — BB A5 supplies console color + forward EQ + light glue in one box (API = forward/punchy, the contrast to the warm Studer/Neve tape direction)
plugin_build: KIT BB A5.vst3 (VST3, Universal 2 — renders headless via Pedalboard; iLok/PACE, authorized on this machine)
headless_notes: String-enum params (pre_amp_source='Mic Mode', eq_choice='55L', *_filter_type bool) are set by this harness's setattr — apply-vst-chain's float-only dict CANNOT set them. To re-drive the same color on a hotter/colder source, adjust pre_amp_gain (color/glue), not input_trim. output is peak-trimmed by the harness so the Mic-gain level jump is handled.
notes: Color source ranking (measured, 1 kHz harmonic probe): MIC + pre_amp_gain is the strongest (2nd+3rd; H3 -64->-14 dB as gain 0->100). LINE mode adds only level-driven 3rd harmonic (channel amp). MSTR BUSS = CLEAN (harmonics -> -150 dB) on a single render — it does NOT add glue here, opposite of the marketing copy. So for grit use Mic drive; for a transparent EQ pass flip to Line + MSTR BUSS.

55L low band is a BELL at type:false (focused weight at 100); set type:true for a low SHELF (broad sub lift). High band type:true = air SHELF. There is NO Q control (proportional-Q: gain widens/narrows the bell).

Keep the top modest (high-mid <=2 dB): API forwardness AND harshness both live 2-5 kHz, and proportional-Q auto-narrows a big boost there into a brittle peak (the api-vision lesson). Get punch from low weight + de-box, not the top.
For more aggression/glue (squashed crest ~8), switch to Line Mode + master_fader 10 + input_trim ~6 (drives the channel amp hard) — a 'smash' variant, re-measure crest.
pre_amp_gain steps integer 0..100; gains/freqs are stepped enums but 55l_continuous_gain:true lets you set any +/-dB. master_fader -96..+10, input_trim/output_trim +/-36.
